name: timeline_file_range_map
description: Map an exact half-open range of a saved project between source and sequence or group and assembly clocks. Repeated occurrences appear separately.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Identical requests can reuse it while running and for ten minutes after completion while the same desktop local-control session or standalone file worker is active.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the saved .cut project.

from.description: Inclusive rational time in the selected clock.

to.description: Exclusive rational time in the selected clock.

file.description: Absolute path identifying one source file.

occurrence_index.description: Zero-based occurrence index in the saved project.

name: history_file_compare
description: Compare two saved .cut projects and report project fields and occurrence ranges that changed.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Identical requests can reuse it while running and for ten minutes after completion while the same desktop local-control session or standalone file worker is active.

before_project_path.description: Absolute path to the earlier saved .cut.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the later saved .cut.

name: multicam_file_sync_suggest
description: Analyze a saved multicam project for offsets, waveform matches and drift. With a replacement file and explicit stream indices, also report offsets relative to the selected camera recording.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Identical requests can reuse it while running and for ten minutes after completion while the same desktop local-control session or standalone file worker is active.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the saved multicam .cut.

source_id.description: Analyze one recording other than the reference. Defaults to all other recordings.

reference_source_id.description: Choose a recording on the reference camera for group sync, or any camera recording for replacement sync.

reference_stream.description: Absolute scratch stream index for replacement sync.

replacement.description: Absolute path to a replacement recording.

replacement_stream.description: Absolute audio stream index in the replacement recording.

program.description: Evaluate coverage across the entire program. Omit reference_stream for a video-only reference.

seed.description: Optional starting offset relative to the scratch recording.

metadata_only.description: Skip waveform analysis and drift checks.

name: multicam_file_switch_coverage_read
description: Check picture and routed sound through the proposed group switch interval in a saved multicam project.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Identical requests can reuse it while running and for ten minutes after completion while the same desktop local-control session or standalone file worker is active.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the saved multicam .cut.

angle_id.description: Camera angle ID for the proposed switch.

group_time.description: Exact proposed group time in rational seconds.
